summary: Primary-source review since 2026-11-21 08:30 Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh found no newly verified material AI-specific realized-employment evidence changing Career Radar. BLS October payroll data (released Nov 6), BLS 2025-2035 projections (Aug 27), OECD/IMF labor-market conference (Nov 17-18), and ILO Vietnam exposure commentary (Nov 2) are older or non-causal and do not justify a new claim. Job postings are not payroll; AI exposure is not adoption or displacement; forecasts, surveys and observational associations are not causal employment effects. OECD Nov 17 work-organisation intake previously rejected and must not be duplicated.
